reason: A TypeScript/Node.js SDK for orchestrating DeepSeek Harness coding-agent turns through a managed runtime subprocess and JSON-RPC protocol.

summaries.zh: 用于通过受管理的运行时子进程和 JSON-RPC 协议编排 DeepSeek Harness 编码智能体回合的 TypeScript/Node.js SDK。
summaries.en: A TypeScript/Node.js SDK for orchestrating DeepSeek Harness coding-agent turns through a managed runtime subprocess and JSON-RPC protocol.

capabilities: Spawns and manages a DeepSeek Harness runtime subprocess
Sends prompts and receives agent responses and event notifications over JSON-RPC stdio
Can configure agent workspace, sessions, model endpoints, API credentials, and runtime environment
Supports coding-agent turns that may act within the configured workspace
